$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#2545). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. The pulumi kind (#3179) moved here from the terraform lexicon (#4453) and keeps its name, which behold keys on. Its graph block reads the pulumi stack export checked in beside Pulumi.yaml as stack-export.json (src/workspace-member.ts); with no export the member has no nodes and meta.pulumiMember says why. The graph read never runs pulumi. The change set (src/change-set.ts) and drift (src/drift-record.ts) run pulumi preview and pulumi refresh --preview-only, which the ruling on #4450 allows, and nothing else.
